The anchored-storage lemma derives the exact two-cycle overflow formula, and the capped affine two-step inequality proves universal weak ordering. Both candidate storage differences are strict simultaneously precisely for a<b<c and B<C; positive increasing-cycle runoff then reduces to qB+c>C. Eliminating the unsaturated states gives the exact open capacity interval. No numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof. Rational checker independently solves 16500 capped-composition fixed points, including boundary and equality cases and witness 5/16 versus 1/8.

value.rationale: The answer is a natural complete classification of the smallest nontrivial temporal-order problem in an event-driven runoff store. It proves both a global weak ordering over every capacity and a nonempty sharp interval in which storm rearrangement strictly increases spill, identifying precisely where rainfall sequencing information matters to a planner despite identical depths. The claim does not rely on a minor numerical increment or a chosen arbitrary parameter slice; no broader hydrology forecasting assertion is made.
